No. Psc-R(B)/28l2021 Dated ltanatar, the 4th October,2021.
The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission invites applications online from the citizens of
lndia, for filling up of 18 (eighteen) posts of Horticulture Oevelopment Officer (HDO), Group-A (Junior)
Horticulture Service, in the Pay Matrix Level-10, Rs.55,100-1,77,500/- P.M. plus other allowances as
admissible in the Arunachal Pradesh Govt. from time to time under the Department of Horticulture. Out
of 18(eighteen) posts, 14 (fourteen) posts are reserved for APST candidates and 04 (four) posts are un-
reserved. The vacancy position is subject to variation. Any vacancy/post (s) if received from Horticulture
Department will be included and notified before the written examination is held.
1 HOW TO APPI-Y:
(a) Before applying online, candidate must mandatorily carry out ONE TIME REGISTRATION (OTR) on
the Commission's website www.allpsc.gov.in
(b) Candidates are required to apply online using the website www-a posc.sov. in. Detail instructions
for One Time Registration (OTR) and Online Application are available on the above-mentioned
website. The applicants are advised to submit only single application; However, if due to any
unavoidable situation, a candidate submits another/multiple applications, then he/she must ensure
that application with the higher Registration lds (RlD) is complete in all respect like Applicant's
details, Photograph, Si8nature, Photo lD, Fee etc. The application with higher RID shall be
entertained by the Commission. Fee paid against one RID shall not be adjusted against any other
RID.
(c) Those candidates who have already registered in OTR need not register again and they can directly
log in to fill up online form using their User lD and Password.
AGE TIMIT:
A candidate must not be less than 18 years and above 32 years of age as on L9/7L|2O2L.
However, upper age limit is relax-able in accordance with the orders issued by the Govt. of
Arunachal Pradesh from time to time in respect of Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe candidates.
3. ELIGIBILITY:
The applicants must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Horticulture Science from a recognised
University. However, candidates that have appeared or are appearing in the final semester
examination shall also be eligible to apply, subject to production of original ce rtificate/ma rk sheet
at the time of viva voce/lnterview.
4. METHOD OF SELECTION:
The eligible candidate will have to appear in the written examination in the following
subjects followed by viva-voce,:
1. General English 100 Marks
2. General Knowledge 100 Marks
3. Horticulture Science Paper-l 100 Marks
4. Horticulture Science Paper-ll 100 Marks

Voce/Personality Test.

(i) Recent passport size photographs.

(iii) Self-attested Xeroxed copy of Matriculation certificate for proof of age issued by the Board
only will be accepted.
(iv) Self-attested Xeroxed copy of APST certificate for APST candidates and PRC/Aadhaar
Card/EPIC for candidates other than APST.
(v) All the supporting documents submitted by the candidates must be self-attested other-
wise the application will be rejected.
Qualified candidates will have to produce the above mentioned certificates and mark-
sheet/documents in oriBinal at the time of lnterviedViva-voce, failing which he/she will not be allowed
to appear in the lnterview.
N.B: ln case there are a large number of applicants, the Commission may conduct an lnitial
Recruitment Test (OMR Based Objective Type) on Horticulture Subject, to limit the number of candidates
for the Written Examination to 12 times the advertised posts.
7. The decision of the Commission as to the eligibility or other-wise of a candidate for admission to
written examination or selection will be final and no correspondence or personal enquiry will be
entertained.

11. A candidate who is or has been declared by the Commission to be guilty of:
A. Obtaining support for his/her candidature by any unfair means or,
B. lmpersonation or,
C. Procuring impersonation by any person, or
0. Submitted fabricated documents or documents which have been tampered with or
E. Making false or incorrect statement or suppressing material fact or information or
F. Resorting to any other irregular or improper means in connection with his/her candidature for the
examination or
G. Using unfair means during the examination or
H. Writing irrelevant matter, including obscene language or pornographic matter in the scripts or
l. Misbehaving in any other manner in the Examination Hall or
J. Harassing or doing bodily harm to the Supervisory Officers/lnvigilators/Staff employed by the
Commission for the conduct of examination or
K. Violating any of the instructions issued to the candidate along with their Admission Certificate/call
Letter permitting them to take the examination, or Commission or as the case may be attempting
the Commission of all or any of the acts specified in the foregoing clauses by a candidate may, in
addition to rendering him/her to criminal prosecution be liable:
i. To be disqualified by the Commission from the Examination for which he/she is a candidate
or
ii. To be debarred permanently or for specified period.
a. By the Commission from any examination or selection held by them.
b. By the State Government from any employment under them and
iii. lf he/she is already in-service under the Government, disciplinary action under the relevant
rules shall be instituted.
iv. Provided that no penalty under these rules shall be imposed except after:
a. Giving the candidate an opportunity of making such representation in writing as
he/she wishes to make in that behalf and
b. Taking the representation if any, submitted by the candidate within the period
allowed to him into consideration.
c. Provided further that if any candidate found to have been debarred by any other
commission the candidate shall stand so debarred for the purpose of this
Commission.
CANDIDATES ARE STRONGLY ADVISED TO APPTY ONLINE WELL IN TIME WITHOUT WAITING FOR
